rows.rule: Destination basis times a half-turn about portal up times inverse source basis; rotate position, velocity and heading together.
rows.acceptance: Round-trip transform recovers position and velocity; speed and vector angles are unchanged.

rows.rule: Cross only from positive to nonpositive signed distance; interpolate the swept segment-plane hit and require the actor radius to fit within the aperture.
rows.acceptance: Reject back-to-front motion, off-aperture travel, degenerate segments, invalid frames and nonfinite inputs.

rows.rule: Translate transformed position outward along destination normal by clearance; never scale velocity. Caller must separately verify destination collision clearance.
rows.acceptance: Exit translation has no effect on velocity or orientation; no unvalidated destination is accepted by game adapter.
